9608c793: ;
This routine is used to edit the status of a patient's appointment in the
VISTAAppointment System. It contains the main control logic for editing
the status field, including input validation, data retrieval, and data
storage.
23f9a782: Call the DE subroutine to setup data elements and then go to BEGIN label
94c8e5b6: Set up variables for editing: DIE=file global root, DIC=DIE, DP=file #, DL=0 for WordProcessing,DIEL=0 for no LAYGO, DU=null for lookup value, clear DG, DE, DB. Quit if no data node exists.
4c7374d5: If data node exists, get the current value of STATUS field into DE(1)
0d38cba1: Kill %Z
acd5cdb6: Write prompt for editing STATUS field
c07d529d: Return
0e99e195: Call the W subroutine to write prompt, then write out field value Y. If value is longer than 19 characters and not a word-processing field, branch to RW^DIR2
8e20fd1e: If Y is null and field is not word-processing, and is either free-text or key'ed, branch to RW^DIR2
76827070: If Y is not null, write '// '. If not word-processing and this is an IDENTICAL field, set X=null, write msg '(No Editing)' and quit
753274a9: Read new value into X up to DTIME seconds. Set DTOUT=1 if time runs out, set X='^' on timeout. Write * character on timeout.
7aa0f228: Return
7c2e46ca: Kill DQ array entry to reset and increment DQ
40b77c85: Branch to label corresponding to value in DQ
88f53266: If a previous value exists in DE(DQ), go to PR label. Otherwise, call W to write prompt and TR to read input.
